services.desc: To celebrate the United State's 250th's anniversary, the Museum of the Oregon Territory will offer FREE ADMISSION to visitors on Friday, July 3, 2026! Come and see our newest exhibits, such as "Land & People of the Willamette Valley: A History Shaped by River," and "Jennings Lodge Camp: A Gathering of Faith, Community, and Revival." Visitors can get hands-on by building a simulated campfire, sending a telegraph, taking on the role of engineers figuring out to channel power to Portland, and many more interactive activities.
